user.title: Sign in to HappyParking
user.description:
### [→ Sign in with Kakao]({auth_url})

Open that link, sign in as you normally would, and you will be sent back to the HappyParking site.

Then copy the **whole address** out of your browser's address bar and paste it below. Your parking server, user id and site code are read out of it — there is nothing else to fill in.

Kakao only ever sends you back to HappyParking's own site, never to Home Assistant, which is why this last step has to be a copy and paste.

*If the page moves on before you can copy the address:* open developer tools → Application → Local Storage → copy the value of `token` and paste that instead.

*Not a Kakao account?* Leave the box empty and submit to pick another sign-in method.
